title: Customer Order Ingress Event
description: Order received by api_gateway and published to synapse.orders.demand (topic #17, ADR-029). This is an INGRESS event from the outside world; it is NOT an inter-agent message.

idempotency_key.description: Client-provided Idempotency-Key from HTTP header; ties retried HTTP requests to the same logical order

timestamp.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp; api_gateway sets this on receipt

trace_id.description: W3C traceparent header value to correlate with downstream consumers

customer_hash.description: Hashed customer identifier (no PII per WS-7)
